about: A second reading of the 30 merged pull requests that docs/backtest.json counts as having a failed check. The recorded scan (docs/agent_pr_ci.json, read 2026-10-01) is not changed: this file is a layer over it, and scripts/backtest.py computes the reviewed counts from both. The rules are in docs/INDEX_METHOD.md.
how: each pull request page on github.com, and its commits page where the main page did not load whole; default branches from each repository's main page

rules.R1: not merged when read again: excluded
rules.R2: merged into a branch other than the repository's default branch: excluded
rules.R3: the claim does not cover the check that failed (a template box limited to required checks when the failed check is not required; a box about manual tests; a description that itself reports the failing job): excluded
rules.R4: the page read again shows every check passed and no failed one, so the recorded failure cannot be confirmed: excluded
rules.R5: the page cannot be read: excluded
rules.kept: a box the agent ticked counts as the agent's claim, template or not; the claim kind is recorded so a reader can drop template boxes too (`template_box`; backtest.json `reviewed.without_template_boxes`)

not_reread: The 211 merged pull requests with no failed check were not read again. The denominator stays 241: these exclusions only lower the counts.
